title: Topic 2.1: The Inspired Word of God

pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE INSPIRED WORD OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.1: The Inspired Word of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Inspired Word of God. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you respect the Holy Bible?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the books in the Old and New Testament
2. role play naming some books in the Bible

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the books in the Old and New Testament
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the books in the Old and New Testament. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. role play naming some books in the Bible
   In simple words: practise until you can role play naming some books in the Bible. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Inspired Word of God using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Inspired Word of God in the examples.
2. Explain The Inspired Word of God to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Inspired Word of God.
4. Show that you can: identify the books in the Old and New Testament

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Inspired Word of God using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Inspired Word of God important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing a song related to respecting the Holy Bible,
2. Role-play ways of handling the Holy Bible with respect,
3. In pairs, observe and read charts containing books in the Old and New Testament,
4. Play games on naming some books in the Old and the New Testament,
5. Collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners contribute to group discussions and take up different roles while singing and role playing.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you respect the Holy Bible?
2. Why is it important to know the books in the Holy Bible?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the books in the Old and New Testament
2. role play naming some books in the Bible

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
